role: Explicit hand-engineered graph-task solver, not learned/CRAMbaseline and never injected into its inference or selection. Reused H2u inputs, no new accuracy-distribution evidence.
algorithm: Single-threaded ordinary unweighted BFS from supplied start over supplied orthogonal open-cell graph; fixed neighbororder up,left,right,down; parent-pointer reconstruction; walls excluded; supplied goal selected; returns exactly one shortestpath per graph. No model weights.

timing.warmup: One64-input call on existing preflight/reserved inputs before measurement.
timing.solve_scope: Preloaded contiguous uint8input tokens; include wrapper calls, output/distance/status allocation, Cqueue/parent allocation, BFS/traversal/reconstruction and fullCPUboard output. Exact full16384-input solve each repetition, preserve all3timings. No threadparallelism.
timing.io_scope: Archive token loading/stacking measured separately in3repetitions; do not flush OS cache. Artifact serialization and independent verification outside solver time and separately reported.
timing.comparison: Report observed BFS seconds/graph alongside existing H2u native and decoder component sums divided by49152model-inputs, explicitly average per-model per-input compute. Raw BFS16384outputs and CRAM49152fixed-modeloutputs shown separately. Do not confuse summedGPUtime with parallelwall latency or count fixed-model repeats as independent inputs.

validation: Independent Dijkstra/BFS-distance and endpoint/wall/degree/connectivity check on every output; compareexact shortest_edges to frozeninputaudit. Deterministic repeatedoutputs hash/parity; fixtures for unique, tied,disconnected and invalidendpoint graphs.
interpretation: Report BFS result even if much faster; suppliedgraph structure makes direct algorithms relevant scopecontrols. No learned-generalization claim for BFS.
